records.name: Pennsylvania Fibershed
records.summary: A group working to make Pennsylvania's fiber and textile trade fairer and more sustainable. It connects fiber growers, makers and businesses, runs a book club, and hosts the Philly Fiber Fest.
records.what_you_do: Read along in the book club, come to Philly Fiber Fest to shop, meet makers and learn, or sign up to volunteer or become a member.

schedule.text: Book club meeting listed for November 10, 2026. Philly Fiber Fest listed for Saturday, December 5, 2026.

cost.text: Ticket prices for the Fest are not listed on the page

first_step.how: Come to Philly Fiber Fest on Saturday, December 5, 2026 at the Village of Industry & Art, or sign up for the book club on the group's Book Club page
first_step.basis: The Fest is open to the public, and the book club and mailing list have sign-up pages

records.notes: Legal name is All Together Now Pennsylvania Inc (IRS record and the site's copyright line); the site brands as Pennsylvania Fibershed. The batch website was pafibershed.org, which is the same group. The site publishes no street address, email or phone. The Fest is co-hosted with The Weaving Circle. Both event dates are listed for late 2026 with no post dates shown, so last_sign_of_life is the earliest listed event month.

records.name: Anna-Maria Moggio International Piano and Voice Competition
records.notes: An annual competition for pianists and singers aged 18 to 35 at application, run by a Pennsylvania nonprofit. The site lists entry deadlines and finals (Semi-Finals and Finals in Pennsylvania, February 28 to March 1, 2026) but no public volunteer, attendance or class route, and it does not name a city for the finals. The only public route is entering as a competitor, so it is hidden as private. This is a judgment call: the owner may prefer out_of_area or not_a_group. Site contact: moggiocompetition@gmail.com.

records.notes: The site returns a Coming Soon placeholder on both the www and bare domain, both checked. No programs, dates, address or contacts are shown. The IRS filing address is 1113 E Montgomery Ave, 19125, not recorded as a location. No search was left, so no outside source was checked. Held back (no categories, interests or audience) until a live page or public listing is found.

records.name: Antigravity Performance Project
records.summary: An ensemble that makes live, mixed-form performance, with members taking turns leading each new piece. The newest show listed is from 2019 or 2020.
records.what_you_do: Watch the company's shows when they are staged. The site lists no classes, auditions or volunteer roles.

cost.text: No ticket or class costs are listed on the site

first_step.how: Join the e-newsletter on the company's site to hear when a new show is announced
first_step.basis: No classes or open calls are listed, so the only public way in is the newsletter and buying show tickets

records.notes: The newest dated item is the show Legal Tender, which the page gives as 2019/2020, so no month is recorded. Other listed shows are older (2012 to 2018). The site has no news or upcoming events and no email or address. The closest tag is community_theater, but the company makes professional ensemble work, not community theater. Publish is a judgment call: the owner may prefer to hide dormant performance companies with no public way in.

records.name: Arcadia Commons
records.summary: Neighbors who look after three green spaces in East Kensington so people have places to gather: Kern Park, The Huntingdon Emerald and the Emerald Wildflower Garden.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer to help keep the green spaces going, or join the mailing list to hear what is happening. Donations are also accepted.

locations.label: East Kensington green spaces: Kern Park, The Huntingdon Emerald, Emerald Wildflower Garden

cost.text: No cost is stated for volunteering or joining. The site only has donation links.

first_step.how: Email info@arcadiacommons.us or call 267.908.9038 to ask about volunteering, or join the mailing list on the website
first_step.basis: The site invites visitors to volunteer and to join the mailing list, though it gives no set times

records.notes: The batch website www.arcadiacommons.org redirects (301) to www.arcadiacommons.us, which was read. The site shows no dated events or news, so the status of probably_active rests on a working site alone. The IRS filing address (2040 E Dauphin St) is not published on the site and is not recorded as a location.

records.name: Arthropoda Foundation
records.notes: A grant-making foundation that funds research on arthropod welfare, with a call for proposals and a donate page. It is a private foundation, which is out of scope for the directory. The batch address arthropodafoundation.org redirects to arthropoda.org, which was read. No public events, classes or volunteer roles.

records.name: Double Trellis Food Initiative
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that cooks meals for people in need, including unhoused neighbors, and gives them to partner programs. It also runs a four-month culinary training program for young adults who were formerly incarcerated.
records.what_you_do: News coverage says the group cooks meals and runs the training program, and points readers to its website for ways to help. The website did not load during this check, so volunteer and donation options are not confirmed.

first_step.how: Visit doubletrellis.org to ask how to volunteer or donate, and confirm the details first, since the site did not load when checked

records.notes: The batch website www.doubletrellis.org returned HTTP 404 on the root, on the bare domain and on /volunteer, so the group's own site could not be read. The 6abc report is dated Wednesday, April 16, 2025. The PhillyDaily feature shows September 4, 2024 and an unlabeled May 15, 2026 stamp; the 2026 stamp might be an update date, which would make the status active, so it was not used. The PhillyDaily feature says the group produces about 300 meals a day. Named training partner: YEAH Philly (lead). The Idealist and Flipcause profiles surfaced in search were not used for facts. One of the two WebSearch calls was used here.

records.name: Friends of Crease Street Garden
records.summary: Neighbors who look after the Crease Street Garden in Fishtown as a shared green space to rest and gather. They share garden workdays and events through a mailing list.
records.what_you_do: Join the mailing list to hear about workdays and garden events, then come help out. Small groups can also reserve the garden.

schedule.text: Garden workdays are announced through the mailing list. No workday dates are shown on the site.

cost.text: Joining the mailing list is free. Reserving the garden is free for up to 25 guests in 3-hour slots, and donations are welcome.

first_step.how: Sign up for the mailing list on creasestreetgarden.org to get the next workday, then come out and help
first_step.basis: Workdays are announced to anyone on the public mailing list

records.notes: The Upcoming Events list showed 'unable to load' at the time of the check, so no event dates were seen. The newest dated item is a memorial PDF for the garden's late caretaker, which sits in the 2025/03 upload folder. Named partner: Neighborhood Gardens Trust (lead). The IRS filing address is 1223 Crease St, which is in the 1200 block; the site gives the block only. The email is as published on the site.

records.name: Harriett's Bookclub
records.summary: A book club in Philadelphia run by its own nonprofit. Its website gives an email contact and a newsletter sign-up, but no meeting dates or book list are posted yet.
records.what_you_do: Read and talk about books with the club. The site does not say how meetings work yet, so email to ask how to attend.

first_step.how: Email hello@harriettsbook.club to ask when and where the club meets and how to join
first_step.basis: No meeting details are posted, so the way in is an email to ask

records.notes: Probably active only because the site loads and posts no dates; no event or news item was found. The open_to value public is judged from the public newsletter sign-up, not from a stated rule. The site printed its email in capitals, so it is lowercased here. The site's street address shows an unusual ZIP, which is not recorded. The IRS legal name is Harrietts Bookclub Inc, and the IRS filing address is 258 E Girard Ave, 19125, not verified as a meeting place. The newsletter form said it needs a storage option, so it may not be working.

records.name: Kensington Corridor Trust
records.summary: A nonprofit trust that acquires and develops affordable homes and shops along Kensington Avenue, so that local residents and business owners keep a say over how the property is used. It shares news updates and a business directory.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for news and updates, look through the business directory or the renters and investors pages, or contact the trust to ask how to take part.

cost.text: No event costs are listed. The site has a donation page and a merchandise shop, with no prices shown.

first_step.how: Sign up for the newsletter on kctphilly.org, or email info@kctphilly.org to ask how to get involved
first_step.basis: The site lists no volunteer or membership process, so the way in is unclear beyond the newsletter

records.notes: Probably active only because the working site shows no dated news or events. The only dated item is the 2026 copyright footer, which does not count as evidence. The office address matches the IRS record (3400 J St Ste G12). The email is printed in capitals on the site and is lowercased here.

records.name: Meraki Animal Sanctuary
records.summary: A registered nonprofit animal sanctuary that cares for animals in need until they can go to permanent homes. Volunteers can foster cats, including mother cats and kittens, through its foster program.
records.what_you_do: Foster a cat or a litter in your home, with a starter kit from the sanctuary, or adopt through the Adopt page. You can also donate supplies or money for vet visits. The site does not describe general volunteer shifts.

cost.text: The site lists no fees for fostering. It asks for donations and says fosters receive a starter kit.

first_step.how: Start the Foster Care Application on merakianimalsanctuary.com/foster-care
first_step.basis: Fostering starts with an application, though the site says even one litter or one stray cat helps and offers help with questions

records.notes: Probably active only because the site loads and posts no dated news or events; the newsletter sign-up reported a storage error. No address or phone is published. The IRS filing address is 2519 E Ann St, not recorded as a location. The Adopt page was not read. The foster page places the program in the Philadelphia area.

records.name: United Veterans of Bridesburg
records.summary: The group that runs the Bridesburg Memorial Day Parade, a long-running parade in Bridesburg that dates back to 1946. It also holds a Memorial 5K and 1 Mile Honor Walk that raises money for the parade.
records.what_you_do: Watch the Memorial Day parade, or sign up for the Memorial 5K and 1 Mile Honor Walk. How to help run the parade was not found in the sources read.

schedule.text: The parade runs each Memorial Day. The 2025 Memorial 5K and 1 Mile Honor Walk was on Saturday, May 17, 2025.

locations.label: Bridesburg Recreation Center (5K start and finish)

cost.text: No race fee was shown on the 2025 listing page that was read

first_step.how: Go watch the Memorial Day parade, or register for the Memorial 5K and 1 Mile Honor Walk, which is held on a Saturday in May
first_step.basis: The parade and the race are open to the public; how to join the organizing group was not found

records.notes: Legal name is United Veterans of Bridesburg Parade Organization Inc (the batch record spelled it United Veterans of Bridesburgparade Organization Inc). The batch website field held a group name, not a web address, so no group site was found. One WebSearch was used. The Spirit News article is from 2012 and is used only for the history and for who runs the parade. Details from 2024 parade coverage that appeared only in search summaries were not recorded. A 2025 race listing gives an organizer street address and phone; neither is recorded because the address looks like a residence. Founders named in the 2012 article: VFW Post 2 and American Legion Post 821 (leads).

notes: Searches: 2 of 2 used, both on United Veterans of Bridesburg and Double Trellis, so the budget is spent. Fetches: about 28. No 403, bot check or rate limit was seen. Broken or odd sites: doubletrellis.org returns 404 on the root and on /volunteer; fit2dream.org and vbcgiving.org do not resolve; handsacrossphiladelphia.org has an expired certificate; anonymousbodies.org shows Coming Soon only. Redirects followed: arcadiacommons.org to arcadiacommons.us, and arthropodafoundation.org to arthropoda.org. Four records are unknown with no sources and will be held back: Anonymous Bodies, Fit 2 Dream, Hands Across Philadelphia and Veterans Villages. Two are hidden: Anna-Maria Moggio competition (private, entry only) and Arthropoda Foundation (research grant-maker, out of scope). Judgment calls for the owner: Antigravity Performance Project is published as dormant with no public way in beyond a newsletter; Harriett's Bookclub open_to public is judged from its public newsletter sign-up; the Moggio competition is hidden as private rather than out_of_area; PhillyDaily shows an unlabeled May 15, 2026 stamp next to a September 4, 2024 date, which was not used for Double Trellis status. Legal names that differ from everyday names are in each record's notes. Personal contact names on the batch file were not copied into any record.
